en.title: Live Score and Bracket Tracking
en.excerpt: How athletes track qualification scores in real time, monitor elimination brackets, and scout upcoming opponents.
en.content:
Tracking Live Qualification Scores

During qualification rounds, tap My Qualification in the tournament view. The screen displays each arrow value entered by your lane scorekeeper in real time, along with running 10s and Xs counts.

Monitoring Your Match Bracket

When elimination brackets are published, tap My Elimination. The interface highlights your position in the bracket tree, your next opponent's name, assigned target lane, and match time.

Scouting Upcoming Match Ups

Tap on your opponent's profile to review their qualification average and historical tournament performance.
